description: Compares two DOCX files and returns a compact `@@ Word Patch @@` diff — Adeu's token-level, sub-word patch format — of their text content. Useful for analyzing differences between versions before editing. [Adeu v3.0.6+df9e00c]

compare_clean.description: If True, compares 'Accepted' state. If False, compares raw text.

modified_path.description: Absolute path to the modified DOCX file.

original_path.description: Absolute path to the baseline DOCX file.

reasoning.description: Why do I need to diff these two documents? State this reason before any other parameter.

name: diff_docx_files
